style.vernacular: Neoclassical Empire core in pale yellow and white stucco; Jugend/National Romantic granite and plaster apartment blocks; white and pale functionalist blocks of the 1930s; 1950s-60s prefabricated concrete and plastered or brick suburban estates with flat or low-pitched roofs; red-ochre painted wooden villas and sheds; and modern glass, brick and timber commercial, campus and sports buildings. Dark sheet-metal or bitumen roofs, birch and pine around everything, snow in winter.
style.ornament: Jugend granite masonry with squat tower, arch and carved figures; neoclassical pilasters and cornices; red brick gables and window surrounds on Gothic Revival buildings; red-ochre (punamulta) painted timber; copper window frames and green copper roofs on civic buildings; large plain functionalist window bands; birch groves and granite outcrops.
